merchants.name: merchant_id
merchants.description: Stable synthetic merchant identifier, e.g. M0001.

merchants.name: archetype
merchants.description: One of the 8 fixed merchant archetypes.

merchants.name: business_tier
merchants.description: small | mid | large — drives baseline GMV scale.

merchants.name: signup_date
merchants.description: Synthetic platform signup date, always before the observation window start.

merchants.name: baseline_daily_gmv
merchants.description: Merchant-specific mean daily GMV before trend/seasonality/events/noise.

merchants.name: baseline_daily_txn_count
merchants.description: Merchant-specific mean daily transaction count.

merchants.name: baseline_aov
merchants.description: Merchant-specific baseline average order value.

merchants.name: baseline_refund_rate
merchants.description: Baseline fraction of transactions refunded.

merchants.name: baseline_chargeback_rate
merchants.description: Baseline fraction of transactions charged back.

merchants.name: baseline_fulfillment_delay_days
merchants.description: Baseline average fulfillment delay in days.

merchants.name: baseline_on_time_rate
merchants.description: Baseline fraction of orders fulfilled on time.

merchants.name: baseline_new_customer_rate
merchants.description: Baseline fraction of daily customers who are new.

merchants.name: baseline_pct_pay_card
merchants.description: Baseline card payment share.

merchants.name: baseline_pct_pay_upi
merchants.description: Baseline UPI payment share.

merchants.name: baseline_pct_pay_netbanking
merchants.description: Baseline netbanking payment share.

merchants.name: baseline_pct_pay_wallet
merchants.description: Baseline wallet payment share.

merchants.name: baseline_pct_pay_bnpl
merchants.description: Baseline BNPL payment share.

merchants.name: annual_growth_rate
merchants.description: Organic annualized growth drift applied to baseline GMV/txn, independent of events.

merchants.name: volatility_factor
merchants.description: Day-to-day multiplicative noise std applied to GMV/txn.

merchants.name: liquidity_buffer_days
merchants.description: Target liquidity buffer expressed in days of current GMV.

merchants.name: settlement_cycle_days
merchants.description: Assumed payment settlement cycle (T+N) in days.

merchants.name: weekly_seasonality_profile
merchants.description: Coarse tag describing the archetype's weekly pattern.

daily_observations.name: merchant_id
daily_observations.description: Foreign key to merchants.merchant_id.

daily_observations.name: date
daily_observations.description: Calendar date of the observation.

daily_observations.name: day_index
daily_observations.description: 0-based day offset from the run's start date. Convenience key, monotonic per merchant.

daily_observations.name: gmv
daily_observations.description: Gross merchandise value for the day. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: transaction_count
daily_observations.description: Number of transactions. Never negative, floor of 1.

daily_observations.name: aov
daily_observations.description: Realized average order value for the day (gmv / transaction_count).

daily_observations.name: refund_count
daily_observations.description: Number of refunded transactions. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: refund_amount
daily_observations.description: Total refunded amount. Never negative, never exceeds gmv.

daily_observations.name: refund_rate
daily_observations.description: refund_count / transaction_count.

daily_observations.name: chargeback_count
daily_observations.description: Number of chargebacks initiated. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: chargeback_amount
daily_observations.description: Total chargeback amount. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: chargeback_rate
daily_observations.description: chargeback_count / transaction_count.

daily_observations.name: fulfillment_delay_avg_days
daily_observations.description: Average fulfillment delay in days for the day's orders. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate
daily_observations.description: Fraction of the day's orders fulfilled on time. In [0, 1].

daily_observations.name: customer_count
daily_observations.description: Distinct customers transacting that day. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: new_customers
daily_observations.description: Customers transacting for the first time. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: returning_customers
daily_observations.description: customer_count - new_customers. Never negative.

daily_observations.name: new_customer_rate
daily_observations.description: new_customers / customer_count.

daily_observations.name: pct_pay_card
daily_observations.description: Share of the day's GMV paid via card.

daily_observations.name: pct_pay_upi
daily_observations.description: Share of the day's GMV paid via UPI.

daily_observations.name: pct_pay_netbanking
daily_observations.description: Share of the day's GMV paid via netbanking.

daily_observations.name: pct_pay_wallet
daily_observations.description: Share of the day's GMV paid via wallet.

daily_observations.name: pct_pay_bnpl
daily_observations.description: Share of the day's GMV paid via BNPL.

daily_observations.name: liquidity_balance
daily_observations.description: Simplified mean-reverting settled-funds buffer. Floored at 0.

daily_observations.name: pending_settlement_amount
daily_observations.description: Simplified rolling not-yet-settled amount, based on settlement_cycle_days. Never negative.

events.name: event_id
events.description: Stable synthetic event identifier, e.g. E000123.

events.name: event_type
events.description: One of the 9 event types in config.EVENT_TYPES.

events.name: hard_negative
events.description: True for benign_growth events explicitly designed as growth-without-risk cases.

events.name: start_date
events.description: First day the event has nonzero effect.

events.name: end_date
events.description: Last day of the event's plateau/peak phase before decay, clipped to the run window.

events.name: recovery_end_date
events.description: Last day of the post-event decay tail, clipped to the run window.

events.name: duration_days
events.description: Nominal event duration (onset + plateau), before the recovery tail.

events.name: severity_score
events.description: Normalized 0-1 severity draw for this event instance.

events.name: affects
events.description: Comma-separated list of daily_observations metrics this event perturbs.

labels.name: as_of_date
labels.description: Prediction date t. Only rows with a full future window are included.

labels.name: future_chargeback_amount
labels.description: Sum of chargeback_amount over (t, t+horizon]. Uses future data only.

labels.name: baseline_daily_gmv_trailing
labels.description: Mean daily gmv over the trailing window ending at t (uses only data at/before t).

labels.name: baseline_daily_chargeback_amount_trailing
labels.description: Mean daily chargeback_amount over the trailing window ending at t.

labels.name: baseline_chargeback_rate_trailing
labels.description: Volume-weighted chargeback rate over the trailing window ending at t.

labels.name: label_elevated_chargeback
labels.description: 1 if this future window is a materially elevated chargeback-loss episode, else 0. See config.py thresholds.
